name: Zedonk
summary: Fashion-industry ERP for small and mid-size brands — modular sales, production, inventory and wholesale management with a B2B digital showroom, priced per module on annual billing.
best_for: small and mid-size fashion brands that need sales, production, inventory and wholesale in one system built around size curves, seasons and linesheets
skip_if: you want self-serve, monthly-cancellable software rather than an annual, demo-led ERP. Fashion is the design centre, though the FAQ names lifestyle, interior-design and petswear clients too, so a non-fashion product brand is not ruled out
honest_knock: The 'starting from' wording is doing real work: £166/mo is the floor of the cheapest module, billed annually, so a working setup for a brand that sells wholesale quickly stacks toward £332/mo and beyond — about £4,000 a year before add-ons. There is no trial and no public total: you find out your actual price in a demo call. Budget for the stack, not the sticker.

pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-09, re-read unchanged 2026-09-27 and again 2026-10-20 against zedonk.co.uk/pricing; unchanged since our August reading) Modular fashion-ERP, priced per building block and billed annually, all listed as 'prices starting from': PLM £166/mo, ERP Essential £166/mo, B2C £250/mo and B2B £332/mo. The two upper cards read 'All ERP Essential Features PLUS' — Shopify integration and barcode generation on B2C, the B2B digital showroom on B2B — so those tiers contain the ERP rather than sitting on top of it. No self-serve signup: every tier goes through a demo, and the FAQ states the displayed plans are 'merely examples' and that a plan can be changed at any time. Onboarding and training are included in every plan; the FAQ puts implementation cost (customisation, data migration, integrations) in a separate figure quoted in a consultation. The general FAQ puts the floor as 'from as little as £1990 per year', which is the £166 card times twelve, rounded.
